data.name: Goleminer
data.detailed_description:
Tower defense where enemies are the product. Golems appreciate in value from your towers as they walk across your board, sold at the end by your Refinery. Use a myriad of strange towers to push, stun, teleport, and refine golems all in an attempt to increase profits. Fight against quotas and strict timers to achieve high scores, and unlock new towers and maps.

Towers:

Towers are specialized, so they are strongest when put together. Perhaps you will push two golems together to double the efficiency of a tower, or teleport a golem away from danger. Maybe you teleport a moving projectile to go through the same lines of golems over and over, or you throw a golem to the other side of the board so a tower can hit two at once.

Quotas:

As you play, you accrue profit and gold, where you pocket gold for tower building and profit moves towards your quota. When you complete a quota, time freezes and you get to mine a new golem or unlock a new tower of your choice. Use this 2 minute time freeze to strategically plan your new mines and spend gold on placing down towers. Complete quotas quickly to accrue extra time, then use this extra time in a final stretch to gain as much profit as you can to earn medals.

Maps:

Each map has something new to explore - new golem types, new map hazards, new tools to unlock, new towers, and more. With different possible performances each map, you can explore new maps to gain powerful towers and then go back and destroy previous records with new knowledge and power.

Elements:

Don't assume you can simply find a strategy and stick with it: with 12 different element types for towers, you'll find that each map rewards different combinations of towers. Some elements, like Acid and Venom, both work well for water-based golems, whereas Ice towers will hurt a heat-based golem and a Fire tower will refine it.

data.short_description: Tower defense where enemies are the product. Golems appreciate in value from your towers as they walk across your board, sold at the end by your Refinery. Use towers to push golems off their path, stun golems, and overclock other towers. Fight against quotas and strict timers to unlock more towers.
